headline: Hill's grand slam sparks Phillies past Nationals
recap: The Phillies trailed the Washington Nationals 3-0 through six innings before scoring six unanswered runs to win 6-3 at Citizens Bank Park on Tuesday. Nationals starter Andrew Alvarez departed in the seventh, and reliever Tom Cosgrove (0-1) gave up a bases-loaded grand slam to Derek Hill that put Philadelphia ahead 4-3. Bryce Harper added a two-run homer off Clayton Beeter in the eighth. Aaron Nola allowed all three Washington runs, both on solo and two-run home runs, over six innings and did not factor in the decision. Kyle Backhus (2-1) got the win, Orion Kerkering held the lead, and Jhoan Duran closed it out for his 25th save.
The win was Philadelphia's third straight. The Phillies are 60-53, second in the NL East, 7.5 games behind the division-leading Atlanta Braves.

Philadelphia continues its four-game series with Washington tonight at Citizens Bank Park, first pitch 6:40 PM ET. Jesus Luzardo starts for the Phillies against Nationals right-hander Zack Littell. DraftKings has the Phillies as -270 moneyline favorites.
